config.Enable Expa.name: Enable Expa
config.Enable Expa.description:
Not recommended without Integrated Minecarts (IM)!
When disabled all destinations will be combined into a single list, making it very difficult to navigate.
With Integrated Minecarts: Makes all PolyCarts join IM's customisable minecart menu!
